research_question: On a frozen authorized Rust and TypeScript holdout, does SecureFlow improve validated recall per analyst minute while preserving validated precision relative to unaided expert review?

systems.version_or_cohort: exact release hash required before real sealing
at least three authorized reviewers; identities retained privately

blinding.disagreement_resolution: A third independent adjudicator resolves disagreements against retained evidence.

execution.retry_policy: No retry except a documented infrastructure failure declared before labels are opened.
execution.crash_timeout_policy: Crashes and timeouts are reported separately and scored by the preregistered missing-result rule.

outcomes.uncertainty_method: Paired bootstrap confidence intervals with the resampling unit fixed before execution.
outcomes.success_criterion: SecureFlow validated recall and precision non-inferiority margins must each be at least -5 percentage points, while median analyst minutes must decrease by at least 20 percent.
